levels.surface: عبيد الله بن الفضل بن محمد بن هلال

notes: «عَنْ أَخِيهِ مَعْمَرٍ» is one link whose surface is the name alone (rule 7)
«سَمِعْتُ زَيْدَ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ يَقُولُ» is rule 5; the text gives Zayd no title, so he is a narrator and not written as an Imam (rule 9)
the saying's Husayn («الحسين بن علي (ع)») is in the matn, not the chain
